=== packages/protocol/src/graph.ts ===
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { z } from "zod";

/** v1 wire limits, also enforced before Zod traverses untrusted object input. */
export const GRAPH_JSON_LIMITS = Object.freeze({ maxBytes: 65_536, maxDepth: 16, maxValues: 4_096, maxStringLength: 16_384 });

function isBoundedJson(value: unknown): boolean {
  let values = 0;
  let bytes = 0;
  const ancestors = new Set<object>();
  function visit(item: unknown, depth: number): boolean {
    if (++values > GRAPH_JSON_LIMITS.maxValues || depth > GRAPH_JSON_LIMITS.maxDepth) return false;
    if (item === null || typeof item === "boolean" || (typeof item === "number" && Number.isFinite(item))) {
      bytes += Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(item));
    } else if (typeof item === "string") {
      if (item.length > GRAPH_JSON_LIMITS.maxStringLength) return false;
      bytes += Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(item));
    } else if (typeof item === "object") {
      if (ancestors.has(item)) return false;
      const array = Array.isArray(item);
      const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(item);
      if (array ? proto !== Array.prototype : proto !== Object.prototype && proto !== null) return false;
      const keys = Reflect.ownKeys(item);
      if (keys.length > GRAPH_JSON_LIMITS.maxValues) return false;
      if (array && (item.length > GRAPH_JSON_LIMITS.maxValues || keys.length !== item.length + 1)) return false;
      ancestors.add(item);
      bytes += 2;
      let index = 0;
      for (const key of keys) {
        if (array && key === "length") continue;
        if (typeof key !== "string" || key.length > 256 || ["__proto__", "constructor", "prototype"].includes(key)) return false;
        if (array && key !== String(index++)) return false;
        const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(item, key);
        if (!descriptor || !descriptor.enumerable || !("value" in descriptor)) return false;
        bytes += (array ? 0 : Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(key)) + 1) + 1;
        if (bytes > GRAPH_JSON_LIMITS.maxBytes || !visit(descriptor.value, depth + 1)) return false;
      }
      ancestors.delete(item);
    } else return false;
    return bytes <= GRAPH_JSON_LIMITS.maxBytes;
  }
  // IPC must supply decoded JSON, never executable objects. Accessors are not read.
  // A hostile in-process Proxy is not a supported transport input.
  try { return visit(value, 0); } catch { return false; }
}

function wire<T extends z.ZodTypeAny>(schema: T) {
  return z.preprocess((value, ctx) => {
    if (!isBoundedJson(value)) {
      ctx.addIssue({ code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom, message: "Expected bounded JSON-only graph data" });
      return z.NEVER;
    }
    return value;
  }, schema);
}

export type GraphJsonValue = null | boolean | number | string | GraphJsonValue[] | { [key: string]: GraphJsonValue };
const JsonValue: z.ZodType<GraphJsonValue> = z.lazy(() => z.union([
  z.null(), z.boolean(), z.number().finite(), z.string().max(GRAPH_JSON_LIMITS.maxStringLength),
  z.array(JsonValue).max(GRAPH_JSON_LIMITS.maxValues), z.record(z.string().max(256), JsonValue),
]));
export const GraphJsonValue = wire(JsonValue);

const Version = z.literal(1);
// No trimming/coercion: business identities must not silently collapse.
const Id = z.string().min(1).max(256).regex(/^[^\s\u0000-\u001f](?:[^\u0000-\u001f]*[^\s\u0000-\u001f])?$/);
const Digest = z.string().regex(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
const Commit = z.string().regex(/^(?:[a-f0-9]{40}|[a-f0-9]{64})$/);
const Count = z.number().int().min(0).max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
const Epoch = z.number().int().min(0).max(2);
const Refs = z.array(Id).min(1).max(128);
const Scope = z.object({ schemaVersion: Version, tenantId: Id, principalId: Id, workspaceId: Id }).strict();
/** Claimed/recorded identity only; parsing does not authenticate it. */
export const GraphScope = wire(Scope);
export type GraphScope = z.infer<typeof GraphScope>;

const budgetShape = {
  maxEpochs: z.number().int().min(1).max(3),
  maxBranchAttempts: z.number().int().min(1).max(32),
  maxConcurrentReaders: z.number().int().min(1).max(64),
  maxConcurrentWritersPerRepo: z.literal(1),
  maxActionStarts: z.number().int().min(1).max(100_000),
  deadlineSeconds: z.number().int().min(1).max(604_800),
  tokenReservationLimit: z.number().int().min(0).max(1_000_000_000),
};
export const GraphBudget = wire(z.object({ schemaVersion: Version, ...budgetShape }).strict());
export type GraphBudget = z.infer<typeof GraphBudget>;
const Spec = z.object({

  input: z.object({ taskRef: Id, repositoryRef: Id, baseRevision: Commit, acceptanceRef: Id }).strict(),
  limits: z.object(budgetShape).strict(),
  publication: z.literal("artifact_only"),

export type GraphRunState = z.infer<typeof GraphRunState>;
export const GraphNodeState = z.enum(["pending", "running", "succeeded", "failed", "skipped", "cancelled", "waiting_input"]);
export type GraphNodeState = z.infer<typeof GraphNodeState>;
export const GraphActionState = z.enum(["intent", "running", "confirmed", "failed", "unknown", "cancel_pending", "reconciliation_required", "cancelled"]);

export const GraphErrorCode = z.enum([
  "SPEC_INVALID", "INPUT_CONTRACT_INVALID", "OUTPUT_CONTRACT_INVALID", "JOIN_REVISION_MISMATCH",
  "POLICY_DENIED", "GRANT_EXPIRED", "BUDGET_EXHAUSTED", "ACTION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN", "STALE_GENERATION",
  "CANCEL_UNCONFIRMED", "CHECKPOINT_INCOMPATIBLE", "UNAUTHENTICATED", "SCOPE_MISMATCH", "RUN_MISMATCH",
  "IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT", "REVISION_CONFLICT", "INTERNAL_ERROR",
]);
export type GraphErrorCode = z.infer<typeof GraphErrorCode>;
const ErrorObject = z.object({
  schemaVersion: Version, code: GraphErrorCode, message: z.string().min(1).max(4096),
  retryable: z.boolean(), nextAction: z.enum(["fix_input", "reauthorize", "reconcile", "refresh", "retry", "stop"]),
  nodeId: Id.optional(), epoch: Epoch.optional(), actionId: Id.optional(),
}).strict().superRefine((error, ctx) => {
  if (error.retryable && !["OUTPUT_CONTRACT_INVALID", "INTERNAL_ERROR"].includes(error.code)) {
    ctx.addIssue({ code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom, path: ["retryable"], message: "Error cannot authorize automatic retry" });
  }
});
export const GraphError = wire(ErrorObject);
export type GraphError = z.infer<typeof GraphError>;

const evidenceShape = { candidateRevision: Commit, evidenceRefs: Refs, evidenceDigest: Digest };
const Result = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
  z.object({ schemaVersion: Version, kind: z.literal("implementation_complete"), workspaceLeaseRef: Id, receiptRef: Id }).strict(),
  z.object({ schemaVersion: Version, kind: z.literal("candidate_ready"), candidateRevision: Commit, artifactRefs: Refs, artifactDigest: Digest }).strict(),

  z.object({ schemaVersion: Version, kind: z.literal("ready"), ...evidenceShape, artifactRefs: Refs, publication: z.literal("artifact_only") }).strict(),
  z.object({ schemaVersion: Version, kind: z.literal("workspace"), workspaceLeaseRef: Id, receiptRef: Id }).strict(),
]);
/** References/digests are claims until the daemon validates stored evidence (G16/G19). */

export type GraphResult = z.infer<typeof GraphResult>;

const Metadata = z.object({

  input: z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [

const WorkerRequest = z.object({

  // Worker asks to register-or-return a slot. It cannot allocate logicalAttempt.

export const WorkerActionResponse = wire(z.object({
  schemaVersion: Version, kind: z.literal("worker_action_response"), requestId: Id, generation: Count.min(1), effect: Effect,
  outcome: z.discriminatedUnion("state", [
    z.object({ state: z.literal("confirmed"), result: Result }).strict(),

const TransportContext = wire(z.object({
  schemaVersion: Version, scope: Scope,
  worker: z.object({ graphRunId: Id, generation: Count.min(1) }).strict().optional(),
}).strict());
/** Trusted integration input, deliberately not part of the wire/schema manifest. */
export type AuthenticatedGraphTransportContext = z.infer<typeof TransportContext>;
/**
 * Trusted daemon code must resolve an authenticated connection and its current
 * lease independently of the request/checkpoint. This is an integration seam,
 * NOT authentication implemented by this package. Never derive this callback's
 * result from worker scope, caller flags or a cast. G10/G12 own real verification,
 * authorization, revocation and atomic fencing. Remote identities fail closed
 * until that integration can verify them; there is no local-owner fallback.
 */
export type ResolveAuthenticatedGraphTransport = () => AuthenticatedGraphTransportContext | null;

export class GraphContractError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly code: GraphErrorCode) {
    super(code);
    this.name = "GraphContractError";
  }
}

function authenticate(resolve: ResolveAuthenticatedGraphTransport): AuthenticatedGraphTransportContext {
  if (typeof resolve !== "function") throw new GraphContractError("UNAUTHENTICATED");
  try {
    const result = TransportContext.safeParse(resolve());
    if (result.success) return result.data;
  } catch { /* Fail closed on unavailable/failed authentication. */ }
  throw new GraphContractError("UNAUTHENTICATED");
}

function canonical(value: GraphJsonValue): string {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object") return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(canonical).join(",")}]`;
  return `{${Object.keys(value).sort().map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${canonical(value[key]!)}`).join(",")}}`;
}
function sameScope(left: GraphScope, right: GraphScope): void {
  if (canonical(left) !== canonical(right)) throw new GraphContractError("SCOPE_MISMATCH");
}

/** Schema parsing alone is not inbound authentication. Use this at the trusted boundary. */
export function parseInboundGraphRequest(value: unknown, resolve: ResolveAuthenticatedGraphTransport): GraphRequest {
  const context = authenticate(resolve);
  const request = GraphRequest.parse(value);
  sameScope(request.scope, context.scope);
  return request;
}

export function parseInboundWorkerActionRequest(value: unknown, resolve: ResolveAuthenticatedGraphTransport): WorkerActionRequest {
  const context = authenticate(resolve);
  if (!context.worker) throw new GraphContractError("UNAUTHENTICATED");
  const request = WorkerActionRequest.parse(value);
  sameScope(request.scope, context.scope);
  if (request.graphRunId !== context.worker.graphRunId) throw new GraphContractError("RUN_MISMATCH");
  if (request.generation !== context.worker.generation) throw new GraphContractError("STALE_GENERATION");
  return request;
}

function hash(domain: string, value: GraphJsonValue): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(`${domain}\n${canonical(value)}`, "utf8").digest("hex");
}
/**
 * Digest v1 = SHA-256 of domain + LF + canonical strictly parsed business JSON.
 * Only root metadata (trace/requestedAt) and root idempotencyKey are omitted.
 * Kind, scope, source, expectedRevision and all nested data remain significant.
 * Object keys sort by JS UTF-16 order; arrays retain order; JSON number encoding.
 */
export function computeGraphInputDigest(value: unknown): string {
  const { metadata: _metadata, idempotencyKey: _key, ...business } = GraphRequest.parse(value);
  return hash("osstack.graph.input.v1", GraphJsonValue.parse(business));
}

export function computeGraphEffectKey(value: unknown): string {
  return hash("osstack.graph.effect.v1", GraphEffectIdentity.parse(value));
}

export const GraphIdempotencyRecord = wire(z.object({
  schemaVersion: Version, scope: Scope, idempotencyKey: Id, inputDigest: Digest,
}).strict());
export type GraphIdempotencyRecord = z.infer<typeof GraphIdempotencyRecord>;
const MutationContext = wire(z.object({ currentRevision: Count.optional(), prior: GraphIdempotencyRecord.optional() }).strict());

/**
 * Pure decision over a trusted snapshot, NOT durable dedup/CAS or authorization.
 * After authentication/fencing, look up prior by full scope + key (all kinds).
 * Same key/digest replays even if revision has since advanced; changed digest
 * conflicts. A fresh resume/cancel must match currentRevision exactly. Start has
 * no revision. G08 must bind decision, unique key and mutation in one transaction.
 */
export function validateGraphMutation(value: unknown, snapshot: unknown): "apply" | "replay" {
  const request = GraphRequest.parse(value);
  const { prior, currentRevision } = MutationContext.parse(snapshot);
  if (prior) {
    sameScope(prior.scope, request.scope);
    if (prior.idempotencyKey !== request.idempotencyKey || prior.inputDigest !== computeGraphInputDigest(request)) {
      throw new GraphContractError("IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT");
    }
    return "replay";
  }
  if (request.kind !== "start" && request.expectedRevision !== currentRevision) throw new GraphContractError("REVISION_CONFLICT");
  return "apply";
}

/** Same-generation transport retransmission: keep requestId and every business field. */
export function validateWorkerTransportRetry(previous: unknown, retry: unknown): "replay" {
  const { metadata: _previousMetadata, ...first } = WorkerActionRequest.parse(previous);
  const { metadata: _retryMetadata, ...second } = WorkerActionRequest.parse(retry);
  if (canonical(first) !== canonical(second)) throw new GraphContractError("IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT");
  return "replay";
}

/** Single generated registry document; context/callbacks never cross the wire. */
export const GraphProtocol = z.object({
  spec: GraphSpec, scope: GraphScope, budget: GraphBudget, error: GraphError,
  runState: GraphRunState, nodeState: GraphNodeState, actionState: GraphActionState,
  result: GraphResult, request: GraphRequest, effectIdentity: GraphEffectIdentity,
  workerActionRequest: WorkerActionRequest, workerActionResponse: WorkerActionResponse,
  idempotencyRecord: GraphIdempotencyRecord,
}).strict();

=== packages/protocol/src/graph.test.ts ===
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  GraphSpec, GraphScope, GraphBudget, GraphError, GraphRunState, GraphNodeState,
  GraphActionState, GraphResult, WorkerActionRequest, WorkerActionResponse,
  StartGraphRequest, ResumeGraphRequest, GraphJsonValue, GraphEffectIdentity,
  computeGraphInputDigest, computeGraphEffectKey, parseInboundWorkerActionRequest,
  parseInboundGraphRequest, validateGraphMutation, validateWorkerTransportRetry,
} from "./graph.js";

const scope = { schemaVersion: 1 as const, tenantId: "local", principalId: "owner", workspaceId: "workspace" };
const limits = {
  maxEpochs: 3, maxBranchAttempts: 2, maxConcurrentReaders: 2,
  maxConcurrentWritersPerRepo: 1, maxActionStarts: 64, deadlineSeconds: 3600,
  tokenReservationLimit: 100000,
};
const spec = {
  schemaVersion: 1, template: "code-delivery-v1",
  input: { taskRef: "task", repositoryRef: "repo", baseRevision: "a".repeat(40), acceptanceRef: "acceptance" },
  limits, publication: "artifact_only",
};
const start = {
  schemaVersion: 1, kind: "start", scope, spec, inputArtifactRef: "input", idempotencyKey: "submit-1",
  source: { product: "osstack", requestId: "source-1" },
};
const resume = {
  schemaVersion: 1, kind: "resume", scope, graphRunId: "run", expectedRevision: 4,
  interruptId: "interrupt", idempotencyKey: "resume-1",
  input: { kind: "data", value: { time: 123, trace: { id: "business" }, values: [1, 2] } },
};
const effect = {
  schemaVersion: 1, scope, graphRunId: "run", specHash: "b".repeat(64), epoch: 0,
  nodeId: "implement", logicalAttempt: 1, effectSlot: "invocation",
};
const worker = {
  schemaVersion: 1, kind: "worker_action", requestId: "transport-1", scope,
  graphRunId: "run", generation: 1, specHash: "b".repeat(64), epoch: 0,
  nodeId: "implement", effectSlot: "invocation",
  action: { kind: "implement", inputArtifactRef: "input", workspaceLeaseRef: "lease" },
};
// This callback stands in for trusted daemon connection/lease resolution, not wire data.
const authenticated = () => ({ schemaVersion: 1 as const, scope, worker: { graphRunId: "run", generation: 1 } });
const digest = (value: unknown) => computeGraphInputDigest(value);

describe("graph v1 contracts", () => {
  it("accepts the architecture's fixed artifact-only spec and versioned requests", () => {
    expect(GraphSpec.parse(spec)).toEqual(spec);
    expect(StartGraphRequest.parse(start)).toEqual(start);
    expect(ResumeGraphRequest.parse(resume)).toEqual(resume);
    expect(WorkerActionRequest.parse(worker)).toEqual(worker);
    expect(GraphScope.parse(scope)).toEqual(scope);
  });

  it.each([
    { ...spec, schemaVersion: 2 }, { ...spec, template: "eval(js)" },
    { ...spec, publication: "merge" }, { ...spec, nodes: [] },
    { ...spec, input: { ...spec.input, script: "process.exit()" } },
    { ...spec, limits: { ...limits, extra: 1 } },
    { ...spec, input: { ...spec.input, taskRef: " " } },
  ])("rejects unsupported or unknown spec fields %#", (value) => {
    expect(GraphSpec.safeParse(value).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it.each([
    ["maxEpochs", 4], ["maxEpochs", 0], ["maxBranchAttempts", 0],
    ["maxBranchAttempts", 1.5], ["maxConcurrentReaders", Infinity],
    ["maxConcurrentWritersPerRepo", 2], ["maxActionStarts", Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1],
    ["deadlineSeconds", NaN], ["deadlineSeconds", -1], ["tokenReservationLimit", Infinity],
  ])("bounds budget %s=%s", (key, value) => {
    expect(GraphBudget.safeParse({ schemaVersion: 1, ...limits, [key]: value }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it.each([
    { ...worker, authenticated: true }, { ...worker, logicalAttempt: 2 },
    { ...worker, checkpoint: { grant: true } }, { ...worker, generation: -1 },
    { ...worker, scope: { ...scope, authenticated: true } },
    { ...worker, action: { ...worker.action, command: "rm -rf /" } },
    { ...worker, metadata: { trace: { traceId: "x", principalId: "owner" } } },
    { ...worker, metadata: { requestedAt: "today" } },
  ])("rejects hostile worker envelope %#", (value) => {
    expect(WorkerActionRequest.safeParse(value).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it("distinguishes implementation completion, candidate freeze and code verdict", () => {
    expect(GraphResult.parse({ schemaVersion: 1, kind: "implementation_complete", workspaceLeaseRef: "lease", receiptRef: "receipt" }).kind).toBe("implementation_complete");
    expect(GraphResult.safeParse({ schemaVersion: 1, kind: "candidate_ready", workspaceLeaseRef: "lease" }).success).toBe(false);
    const report = { schemaVersion: 1, kind: "tests", candidateRevision: "a".repeat(40), passed: false, evidenceRefs: ["report"], evidenceDigest: "b".repeat(64) };
    expect(GraphResult.parse(report)).toEqual(report);
    const response = { schemaVersion: 1, kind: "worker_action_response", requestId: "transport-1", generation: 1, effect, outcome: { state: "confirmed", result: report } };
    expect(WorkerActionResponse.parse(response)).toEqual(response);
    expect(WorkerActionResponse.safeParse({ ...response, outcome: { state: "unknown", result: report } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(WorkerActionResponse.safeParse({ ...response, effect: { ...effect, generation: 1 } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(GraphResult.safeParse({ ...report, grant: true }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it("has explicit states and structured non-retryable unknown outcomes", () => {
    expect(GraphRunState.parse("reconciliation_required")).toBe("reconciliation_required");
    expect(GraphNodeState.parse("skipped")).toBe("skipped");
    expect(GraphActionState.parse("unknown")).toBe("unknown");
    const error = { schemaVersion: 1, code: "ACTION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN", message: "Reconcile execution", retryable: false, nextAction: "reconcile", nodeId: "implement", epoch: 0, actionId: "action" };
    expect(GraphError.parse(error)).toEqual(error);
    expect(GraphError.safeParse({ ...error, retryable: true }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(GraphError.safeParse({ ...error, extra: 1 }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("bounded JSON-only values", () => {
  it.each([undefined, NaN, Infinity, 1n, Symbol("x"), () => 1, new Date(), new Map(), /x/, new Uint8Array(1), new (class SDK { value = 1; })(), { x: undefined }, [undefined], new Array(2), { x: "x".repeat(65537) }])("rejects non-wire value %#", (value) => {
    expect(GraphJsonValue.safeParse(value).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ResumeGraphRequest.safeParse({ ...resume, input: { kind: "data", value } }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it("rejects cycles, depth, count and byte overflow before recursive parsing", () => {
    const cycle: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    cycle.self = cycle;
    let deep: unknown = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) deep = { child: deep };
    for (const value of [cycle, deep, Array(5000).fill(0), Array(20).fill("界".repeat(2000))]) {
      expect(GraphJsonValue.safeParse(value).success).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it("rejects getters and hidden/symbol/pollution properties without invoking getters", () => {
    let invoked = false;
    const accessor = Object.defineProperty({}, "x", { enumerable: true, get() { invoked = true; return 1; } });
    for (const value of [accessor, Object.defineProperty({}, "x", { value: 1 }), { [Symbol("x")]: 1 }, JSON.parse('{"__proto__":{"x":1}}')]) {
      expect(GraphJsonValue.safeParse(value).success).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(invoked).toBe(false);
    expect(GraphSpec.safeParse(Object.assign(Object.create({}), spec)).success).toBe(false);
    expect(GraphJsonValue.parse({ nested: [null, true, 1.5, "text"] })).toEqual({ nested: [null, true, 1.5, "text"] });
  });
});

describe("authenticated transport boundary", () => {
  it("requires trusted resolver code, never an authenticated flag in data", () => {
    for (const resolver of [undefined, null, { authenticated: true, ...authenticated() }, () => null, () => ({ ...authenticated(), authenticated: true })]) {
      expect(() => parseInboundWorkerActionRequest(worker, resolver as never)).toThrow(/UNAUTHENTICATED/);
    }
    expect(parseInboundWorkerActionRequest(worker, authenticated)).toEqual(worker);
    expect(parseInboundGraphRequest(start, () => ({ schemaVersion: 1, scope }))).toEqual(start);
  });

  it.each(["tenantId", "workspaceId", "principalId"])("rejects mismatched %s", (key) => {
    expect(() => parseInboundWorkerActionRequest({ ...worker, scope: { ...scope, [key]: "other" } }, authenticated)).toThrow(/SCOPE_MISMATCH/);
    expect(() => parseInboundGraphRequest({ ...start, scope: { ...scope, [key]: "other" } }, authenticated)).toThrow(/SCOPE_MISMATCH/);
  });

  it("rejects run/generation mismatch and missing worker binding", () => {
    expect(() => parseInboundWorkerActionRequest({ ...worker, graphRunId: "other" }, authenticated)).toThrow(/RUN_MISMATCH/);
    expect(() => parseInboundWorkerActionRequest({ ...worker, generation: 2 }, authenticated)).toThrow(/STALE_GENERATION/);
    expect(() => parseInboundWorkerActionRequest(worker, () => ({ schemaVersion: 1, scope }))).toThrow(/UNAUTHENTICATED/);
  });
});

describe("canonical identity and pure mutation decisions", () => {
  it("sorts object keys, keeps arrays and nested business time/trace significant", () => {
    const reversed = { ...resume, input: { value: { values: [1, 2], trace: { id: "business" }, time: 123 }, kind: "data" } };
    expect(digest(resume)).toBe(digest(reversed));
    for (const value of [{ values: [2, 1], trace: { id: "business" }, time: 123 }, { values: [1, 2], trace: { id: "other" }, time: 123 }, { values: [1, 2], trace: { id: "business" }, time: 124 }]) {
      expect(digest({ ...resume, input: { kind: "data", value } })).not.toBe(digest(resume));
    }
  });

  it("excludes only declared envelope metadata and idempotency routing key", () => {
    expect(digest({ ...start, metadata: { trace: { traceId: "trace", spanId: "span" }, requestedAt: "2026-09-13T12:00:00Z" } })).toBe(digest(start));
    expect(digest({ ...start, idempotencyKey: "retry-key" })).toBe(digest(start));
    for (const value of [{ ...start, time: 1 }, { ...start, metadata: { business: 1 } }, { ...start, spec: { ...spec, trace: "business" } }, { ...start, source: { ...start.source, extra: 1 } }]) {
      expect(() => digest(value)).toThrow();
    }
    expect(digest({ ...start, inputArtifactRef: "changed" })).not.toBe(digest(start));
    expect(digest({ ...start, scope: { ...scope, tenantId: "other" } })).not.toBe(digest(start));
  });

  it("binds effects to scope/run/spec/epoch/node/ledger attempt/slot, never generation", () => {
    expect(computeGraphEffectKey(effect)).toMatch(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
    for (const changes of [{ scope: { ...scope, workspaceId: "other" } }, { graphRunId: "other" }, { specHash: "c".repeat(64) }, { epoch: 1 }, { nodeId: "repair" }, { logicalAttempt: 2 }, { effectSlot: "other" }]) {
      expect(computeGraphEffectKey({ ...effect, ...changes })).not.toBe(computeGraphEffectKey(effect));
    }
    expect(GraphEffectIdentity.safeParse({ ...effect, generation: 2 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(() => computeGraphEffectKey({ ...effect, logicalAttempt: 0 })).toThrow();
  });

  it("replays the same key/input before revision CAS but conflicts on changed business input", () => {
    const prior = { schemaVersion: 1, scope, idempotencyKey: resume.idempotencyKey, inputDigest: digest(resume) };
    expect(validateGraphMutation(resume, { currentRevision: 4 })).toBe("apply");
    expect(validateGraphMutation(resume, { currentRevision: 5, prior })).toBe("replay");
    expect(() => validateGraphMutation({ ...resume, input: { kind: "data", value: 2 } }, { currentRevision: 5, prior })).toThrow(/IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT/);
    expect(() => validateGraphMutation(resume, { currentRevision: 5 })).toThrow(/REVISION_CONFLICT/);
    expect(() => validateGraphMutation(resume, { currentRevision: -1 })).toThrow();
    expect(() => validateGraphMutation(resume, {})).toThrow(/REVISION_CONFLICT/);
    expect(() => validateGraphMutation(resume, { currentRevision: 4, prior: { ...prior, scope: { ...scope, tenantId: "other" } } })).toThrow(/SCOPE_MISMATCH/);
    expect(() => validateGraphMutation({ ...resume, expectedRevision: 5 }, { currentRevision: 5, prior })).toThrow(/IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT/);
    expect(validateGraphMutation(start, {})).toBe("apply");
  });

  it("keeps worker transport retries identical except declared metadata", () => {
    expect(validateWorkerTransportRetry(worker, { ...worker, metadata: { trace: { traceId: "new" } } })).toBe("replay");
    for (const changes of [{ requestId: "new" }, { generation: 2 }, { action: { ...worker.action, inputArtifactRef: "other" } }]) {
      expect(() => validateWorkerTransportRetry(worker, { ...worker, ...changes })).toThrow(/IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT/);
    }
  });
});

=== docs/implementation/graph-kernel-evidence/review-followup.md ===
# Supervisor notes for G05–G07

This file contains supervisor-adjudicated implementation guidance. It is not a request to expand into M1.

- G05: authentication is a trusted transport/registry resolver responsibility. Strict schemas alone do not authenticate an identifier. Keep pure inbound validation useful and require external trusted identity; do not claim a caller-set authenticated boolean proves identity. Expected revision/idempotency helpers are pure decisions, not atomic DB enforcement.
- G06: parent verified registry metadata for LangGraph 1.4.15, core 1.2.11 and checkpoint 1.1.5; these are the intended exact direct candidates. Protocol remains Zod3. Local Node22 binary is `/opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin/node` (22.22.1); Node20.20.2 and native SQLite smoke evidence are located in the temporary controller directory recorded by `/tmp/osstack-graph-kernel-current-path.txt`. Parent handles independent Node20/22 checks; do not claim all Node20 minors or complete OSStack compatibility. Fresh fixture better-sqlite3 12.10.0 in-memory read/write passed on both ABIs.
- G07: inspection of the actual installed checkpoint 1.1.5 public declarations confirms deleteThread is abstract in addition to getTuple/list/put/putWrites. Account for inherited get, getNextVersion, and getDeltaChannelHistory (beta) in the capability decision. v1 can exclude DeltaChannel, but document it explicitly. WRITES_IDX_MAP, ERROR/INTERRUPT/RESUME/SCHEDULED/TASKS and SerializerProtocol are publicly exported; no deep private imports are needed.
- G07: pending-write dedup is taskId + write index, with negative reserved channel indexes replacing earlier values while ordinary indexes retain first committed values. Test a repeated putWrites call and reserved error overwrite separately. Test-only persistent saver should not borrow MemorySaver internals or serialize its private storage property.
- G07: checkpoint v4 is the declared supported format. Old-format migration and arbitrary class revival are outside v1; reject unsupported formats explicitly rather than silently dropping fields. Demonstrate real failed-parallel-superstep recovery with completed sibling invocation count unchanged across separate processes, plus interrupt/resume and saver failure propagation if supported.

=== pinned checkpoint 1.1.5 public declarations ===
import { SerializerProtocol } from "./serde/base.js";
import { CheckpointMetadata, CheckpointPendingWrite, DeltaChannelHistory, PendingWrite } from "./types.js";
import { RunnableConfig } from "@langchain/core/runnables";

//#region src/base.d.ts
/** @inline */
type ChannelVersion = number | string;
type ChannelVersions = Record<string, ChannelVersion>;
interface Checkpoint<N extends string = string, C extends string = string> {
  /**
   * The version of the checkpoint format. Currently 4
   */
  v: number;
  /**
   * Checkpoint ID {uuid6}
   */
  id: string;
  /**
   * Timestamp {new Date().toISOString()}
   */
  ts: string;
  /**
   * @default {}
   */
  channel_values: Record<C, unknown>;
  /**
   * @default {}
   */
  channel_versions: Record<C, ChannelVersion>;
  /**
   * @default {}
   */
  versions_seen: Record<N, Record<C, ChannelVersion>>;
}
interface ReadonlyCheckpoint extends Readonly<Checkpoint> {
  readonly channel_values: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
  readonly channel_versions: Readonly<Record<string, ChannelVersion>>;
  readonly versions_seen: Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, ChannelVersion>>>>;
}
declare function deepCopy<T>(obj: T): T;
/** @hidden */
declare function emptyCheckpoint(): Checkpoint;
/** @hidden */
declare function copyCheckpoint(checkpoint: ReadonlyCheckpoint): Checkpoint;
interface CheckpointTuple {
  config: RunnableConfig;
  checkpoint: Checkpoint;
  metadata?: CheckpointMetadata;
  parentConfig?: RunnableConfig;
  pendingWrites?: CheckpointPendingWrite[];
}
type CheckpointListOptions = {
  limit?: number;
  before?: RunnableConfig;
  filter?: Record<string, any>;
};
declare abstract class BaseCheckpointSaver<V extends string | number = number> {
  serde: SerializerProtocol;
  constructor(serde?: SerializerProtocol);
  /**
   * Prevent `JSON.stringify` from traversing backend clients (e.g. pg Pool
   * timers) when a checkpointer is present in runnable `configurable`.
   */
  toJSON(): string;
  get(config: RunnableConfig): Promise<Checkpoint | undefined>;
  abstract getTuple(config: RunnableConfig): Promise<CheckpointTuple | undefined>;
  abstract list(config: RunnableConfig, options?: CheckpointListOptions): AsyncGenerator<CheckpointTuple>;
  abstract put(config: RunnableConfig, checkpoint: Checkpoint, metadata: CheckpointMetadata, newVersions: ChannelVersions): Promise<RunnableConfig>;
  /**
   * Store intermediate writes linked to a checkpoint.
   */
  abstract putWrites(config: RunnableConfig, writes: PendingWrite[], taskId: string): Promise<void>;
  /**
   * Delete all checkpoints and writes associated with a specific thread ID.
   * @param threadId The thread ID whose checkpoints should be deleted.
   */
  abstract deleteThread(threadId: string): Promise<void>;
  /**
   * Walk the parent chain returning per-channel writes + seed, used to
   * reconstruct `DeltaChannel` state from `checkpoint_writes`.
   *
   * For each requested channel, walks ancestors of the checkpoint identified
   * by `config` (following `parentConfig`) and accumulates the pending writes
   * for that channel. The walk terminates per-channel at the nearest ancestor
   * whose `channel_values[ch]` is populated; that value is returned as `seed`.
   * If the walk reaches the root without finding a stored value, `seed` is
   * omitted from that channel's entry — the consumer treats the absence as
   * "start empty".
   *
   * Walks the parent chain (not `list({ before })`): for forked threads, only
   * on-path ancestors contribute.
   *
   * The default implementation walks `getTuple` + `parentConfig` once for all
   * channels — each ancestor visited once, not once per channel. Savers with
   * direct storage access (e.g. `MemorySaver`) override for performance; the
   * return contract is fixed here.
   *
   * @remarks Beta. The signature, return shape, and interaction with
   * `DeltaSnapshot` blobs may change. Override at your own risk; the default
   * implementation will continue to work against the public
   * `BaseCheckpointSaver` contract.
   *
   * @param options.config Configuration identifying the target checkpoint.
   * @param options.channels Channel names to walk for. Empty → empty mapping.
   * @returns Per-channel {@link DeltaChannelHistory} for every requested name.
   */
  getDeltaChannelHistory(options: {
    config: RunnableConfig;
    channels: string[];
  }): Promise<Record<string, DeltaChannelHistory>>;
  /**
   * Generate the next version ID for a channel.
   *
   * Default is to use integer versions, incrementing by 1. If you override, you can use str/int/float versions,
   * as long as they are monotonically increasing.
   */
  getNextVersion(current: V | undefined): V;
}
declare function compareChannelVersions(a: ChannelVersion, b: ChannelVersion): number;
declare function maxChannelVersion(...versions: ChannelVersion[]): ChannelVersion;
/**
 * Mapping from error type to error index.
 * Regular writes just map to their index in the list of writes being saved.
 * Special writes (e.g. errors) map to negative indices, to avoid those writes from
 * conflicting with regular writes.
 * Each Checkpointer implementation should use this mapping in put_writes.
 */
declare const WRITES_IDX_MAP: Record<string, number>;
/**
 * Metadata keys that are LangGraph's internal framework bookkeeping and
 * should not be surfaced as user-meaningful metadata.
 *
 * Consumed by stream handlers (e.g. the `tasks` debug stream) to drop
 * framework keys — which are redundant with a task's own fields and
 * namespace — while keeping keys like `lc_agent_name`, `ls_integration`,
 * and user-supplied metadata.
 */
declare const EXCLUDED_METADATA_KEYS: ReadonlySet<string>;
declare function getCheckpointId(config: RunnableConfig): string;
//#endregion
export { BaseCheckpointSaver, ChannelVersions, Checkpoint, CheckpointListOptions, CheckpointTuple, EXCLUDED_METADATA_KEYS, ReadonlyCheckpoint, WRITES_IDX_MAP, compareChannelVersions, copyCheckpoint, deepCopy, emptyCheckpoint, getCheckpointId, maxChannelVersion };
//# sourceMappingURL=base.d.ts.map
